Every time a case of sexual violence or moral policing comes to light, India is forced to confront some uncomfortable questions. The reaction swings between two extremes, demanding that the accused be hanged or finding ways to blame the survivor.
But the Jamui moral policing incident and the Astha Kunj Park rape case revealed another disturbing side to this conversation. Women attacking other women, defending men accused of wrongdoing and questioning the victims instead.
